roles.beyondNote: This role has permissions you don't hold yourself, so you can't change it.
roles.readOnlyNote: You can view this role but not change it.

users.beyondNote: This user holds permissions you don't have, so you can't change them.
users.lockedUntil: Locked until {time} after wrong passwords. A password reset unlocks it.

notices.publishAtHint: Dhaka time. A time in the future schedules the notice.

home.sub: Hero text, figures, upcoming events and emergency numbers

site.sub: Address, office hours and contact in the footer of every page

committee.termEndHint: Leave blank while the end date is not decided.

Property.name: Name
Property.nameHint: As people say it, e.g. রোড ৯ or Road 9.

Property.prefixHint: e.g. “রোড ” or “Flat ”. Include the space if you want one.

levelsPage.sub: The steps of the map, from the top down. The last level holds the units.
levelsPage.rule: A level in use can be renamed but not removed or moved past another level in use. Skipping a level is fine: a plot can hold units directly.

Property.occupancyHint: Follows the records: rented while a tenancy runs, otherwise the owner's when an owner is recorded, otherwise vacant.

Members.fullNameHint: As written on the NID, usually in Bangla.
Members.nidHidden: An NID is on file. Only people who may edit this person see the number.
Members.newHint: Add someone who isn't linked to a unit yet. To add an owner, renter or resident, open the unit instead.
Members.readOnly: You can see this person but not change them.
Members.verifyHint: Check the details against the NID or other papers first.
Members.deleteHint: Only someone not linked to any unit, the committee, a login or bills can be deleted.
Members.orgDeleteHint: Only an organisation with no ownership, tenancy or bill records can be deleted.
Members.monthlyRentHint: Optional, for the police tenant form.

people.title: People
people.ownersAboveHint: Without an owner of its own, this belongs to the owner of the place above.
people.noTenancy: No one rents this unit now.
people.confirmDeleteRow: Delete this record? Only for mistakes; otherwise end it.
people.transferHint: On this date the current owners stop and the owners below start. The old records are kept.
people.reuseHint: If someone with this phone or NID is already recorded, they are linked and their stored details are kept.
people.livesHereHint: If an owner lives in this unit, press “Lives here” to add them as a resident.
people.renterIsResident: A renter who is a person is added as a resident (head of household) automatically.

FormsAdmin.sub: Check and approve applications sent from the website
FormsAdmin.fileCount: {count, plural, =0 {No documents} one {# document} other {# documents}}
FormsAdmin.nidHidden: An NID number was given, but you can't see it.
FormsAdmin.matchHint: Approving uses this person's record: nobody new is added and their stored details stay as they are.
FormsAdmin.rejectReasonHint: Write the reason to tell the applicant.

approveHint.membership: Approving makes the applicant a member of the society with the next member number.
approveHint.renter_registration: Approving opens a pending tenancy of the flat with the whole household. Once they move in, set the tenancy to active on the unit page.

FormsAdmin.addOwnershipHint: Tick once the deed has been checked. The current owners' shares of this place can't add up to more than 100%.
FormsAdmin.noApproveRight: You don't have the permissions needed to approve in this area.

settings.sub: The president's switches, the fiscal year and the receipt header.
settings.readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.
settings.separateFundsHint: When on, money for the mosque, gym and other facilities can be kept in funds of their own. When off, everything goes into the general fund.
settings.shareThana: Share renter details with the thana
settings.shareThanaHint: The renter list for the thana comes later; the decision can be recorded now.
settings.fiscalLocked: The ledger has entries, so the fiscal year start can no longer change.
settings.receiptHeaderHint: What prints at the top of every receipt.

funds.sub: What each fund holds in cash and at the bank, and its opening balance.
funds.singleFund: Only the general fund is in use. To keep mosque or gym money apart, turn on “Separate funds for facilities” in the settings.
funds.closeQuestion: Close this fund? A closed fund takes no more entries. It closes only when it holds nothing and no charge type bills into it.
funds.openingHint: What the fund held on the day you start using the system: in the office cash box and in the bank account. It can be corrected until the first receipt or expense.
funds.correctHint: A correction doesn't erase the earlier figures: the ledger reverses them and records the new ones.

chargeTypes.sub: What bills can charge for: service charge, generator fee, fines.
chargeTypes.readOnly: Only a society-wide billing role can change charge types.
chargeTypes.archived: Archived. New bills won't offer it.
chargeTypes.kindHint: Dues are charged every month or period; a fee is charged once; a fine is added by hand by the office.
